prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose How You Want to Adopt Your Pet", "Select a ready-made desktop companion or upload your own pet photo to create a custom companion."]
1: ["Sign In to Your Desktop Companion Account", "Logging in ensures your pet data, custom creations, and settings are preserved across sessions."]
2: ["Browse Desktop Companions", "Swipe or click through available pet models to find the companion that fits your desktop best."]
3: ["Your Pet Companion is Arriving", "Please hold on while we build and configure your companion for your desktop workspace."]
4: ["Your Pet is Active on Your Desktop", "Your desktop companion is ready. Review quick interaction options on the right before getting started."]
5: ["Upload Pet Photo", "Select a clear front-facing photo of your pet for best custom model results."]
6: ["Your Always-On Desktop Companion", "Adopt or create an interactive companion that lives directly on your desktop screen while you work."]
7: ["Name Your Pet", "Enter companion name", "Official Adoption Certificate"]
8: ["Sign In to Restore Existing Pets", "Log into your account to access your saved desktop companions and sync existing data."]
9: ["Desktop Pet Controls Overview", "Check off basic controls to learn how to move, hide, or communicate with your pet companion."]
